description: Offscreen rendering of a graph overview image and per-workflow thumbnail capture and caching for workflow tab hover previews. Reuses the minimap canvas renderer and spatial bounds calculation; the workflow store, workflow service, and tab components remain with their owning domains.

characterizationScenarios.name: Workflow thumbnails are captured, cached, and shown on tab hover

compatibilityPromises: Existing workflow store, workflow service, and workflow tab imports of thumbnail internals remain visible as cross-domain coupling debt; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
Thumbnail rendering depends on minimap rendering internals without owning them.
